brief: The ML ops stack for teams that don't have ML engineers — 6 tools, zero PhD required.

slots.tagline: Production-grade inference without managing GPUs, training loops, or tensor math.
slots.f1Body: Call frontier models with a single HTTP request and zero infrastructure overhead.
slots.f2Body: Return JSON schemas reliably to feed downstream automations and databases.
slots.f3Body: Few-shot prompting replaces months of model development for most use cases.

slots.tagline: Postgres plus pgvector stores embeddings, metadata, and user data in one open platform.
slots.f1Body: Query semantic similarity with SQL instead of standing up a separate database.
slots.f2Body: Protect tenant data with policies that enforce access at the database level.
slots.f3Body: Run lightweight inference hooks close to your data without leaving the ecosystem.

slots.tagline: Visual workflow automation that chains LLM calls, data transforms, and webhooks together.
slots.f1Body: Drag nodes to create RAG flows, ETL jobs, and alerting without YAML engineering.
slots.f2Body: Keep inference data in your VPC with the fair-code community edition.
slots.f3Body: Start flows from Slack, email, or API calls to close the loop on outputs.

slots.tagline: Frontend and AI API routes deploy globally in seconds with zero DevOps configuration.
slots.f1Body: Stream LLM responses to React components with ready-to-use helpers and hooks.
slots.f2Body: Host inference endpoints that scale to zero so you only pay for usage.
slots.f3Body: Every git branch gets a live URL for safe testing of new prompt versions.

slots.tagline: An AI-native editor that generates boilerplate, tests, and integration logic on demand.
slots.f1Body: Reference your entire codebase so generated scripts match existing patterns exactly.
slots.f2Body: Describe the API integration you need and watch the editor scaffold the route.
slots.f3Body: Catch type errors and logic bugs before they reach CI with real-time suggestions.

slots.tagline: Consistent environments from local laptop to production server without dependency drift.
slots.f1Body: Lock Python, Node, and system libraries so models behave identically everywhere.
slots.f2Body: Spin up Postgres, Redis, and your app with one command for local development.
slots.f3Body: Multi-stage builds keep production containers small and fast to deploy anywhere.

slots.ctaBody: Deploy ML features this week using tools your frontend team already knows. No hiring, no notebooks, no infrastructure.
